description: Conservative local-development planning estimates, not storage guarantees or measured product requirements.

core.description: CRC/MicroShift, 70 GiB LVMS reservation, and at least 100 GiB for root, images, logs, and core AAP services.

headroom.description: Reserved operating headroom for image churn, upgrades, temporary files, and filesystem overhead.

fleet.description: Fleet QCOW2 images and node overlays are stored on the host, outside the CRC VM.

mcp-server.description: MCP workload image, logs, and transient data.

portal.description: Portal workloads, images, and plugin content.

portal-operator.description: Operator, catalog, operand images, and portal data.

setup-pah.description: Configuration-only allowance for temporary synchronization data.

ao.description: Automation Orchestrator, catalog/operator images, PostgreSQL, and demo data.

ao-pr-testing.description: OpenShift MCP server and PR validation execution environment for AO.

apme-eap.description: Early-access portal workloads, plugins, and deployment artifacts.

keycloak.description: Keycloak OIDC provider and its PostgreSQL database.

local-cache.description: Exported container image archives are retained on the host, outside the CRC VM.

product-demos.description: Demo projects, execution content, and related container image growth.

product-demo-satellite.description: Configuration and project content; the Satellite server itself is external.

opa.description: OPA image, policy bundle, and logs.

ollama.description: Ollama image, local model, and runtime data.

satellite-manifest.description: Satellite subscription manifest and lab metadata on the host; the Satellite VM itself is provisioned separately by satellite-lab.
